answered_on_site.question: What should I do if I have a knocked out tooth?
answered_on_site.answer_summary: Do not touch the roots, gently rinse the tooth, replace it in socket or keep it moist in milk, and see a dentist immediately.
answered_on_site.evidence_quote: Only pick up and handle your lost tooth by the sides and chewing surface. Clean the tooth gently. You can use water or milk

answered_on_site.question: What does pediatric dentistry include?
answered_on_site.answer_summary: Pediatric dentistry includes dental sealants on molars to prevent cavities and direct fluoride applications to strengthen tooth enamel.
answered_on_site.evidence_quote: Pediatric dentistry includes using sealants to help prevent cavities and tooth decay on a child’s back molars.

answered_on_site.question: What is IV Sedation Dentistry?
answered_on_site.answer_summary: A sedative administered via an intravenous line allowing real-time adjustment so patients stay relaxed and comfortable during procedures.
answered_on_site.evidence_quote: IV sedation dentistry, also known as sleep dentistry, involves administering a sedative through an intravenous line.
